name: Link
title: Link
summary: Text links for navigation: plain inline links in copy, the `.lnk` underline-reveal link, and the ghost "see all" link with ↗.
whenToUse: Inline `<a>`: a link inside a sentence ("Read our privacy policy").
`.lnk`: a standalone text link in a list, footer or card ("Get prayer updates ↗").
Ghost link (`.btn-ghost`, React `Link variant="ghost"`): a "See all" / "Browse All" link after a section or row of cards.
whenNotToUse: Do not use a link for an action that changes data (submit, give, delete); use Button.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`inline` is a plain link in copy; `reveal` is `.lnk` (underline grows on hover); `ghost` is the "See all" link-button;
`onDark` is for dark surfaces; `ink` is `.lnk` in black at content width.

props.name: external
props.description: Link goes to another site or page: adds the hidden "(opens in a new tab)" text, `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener"`.

props.name: arrow
props.description: Show the trailing arrow glyph (decorative, `aria-hidden`). Pass `true` for ↗ or a node for another glyph. Used on reveal and ghost links.

props.name: newTabLabel
props.description: Visually hidden text announced for external links. Override to translate.

props.name: children
props.description: Specific link text ("Read the statement of faith"), never "here".

props.name: href
props.description: URL opened with `Linking.openURL` when pressed. Use `onPress` alone for in-app navigation.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Called on press, before `href` is opened.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`inline` sits inside a `<Text>` paragraph and stays underlined; `standalone` is the `.lnk` text link in a list, footer or card
(ink colour, underline on press and focus); `ghost` is the semibold blue "See all" link with a 44dp hit area.

props.name: arrow
props.default: "external" when `href` is set and the variant is not `inline`, otherwise "none"
props.description:
Show the arrow after the label. `external` is ↗ (goes to another page or site, never mirrored in RTL);
`drill` is › (drills into an app screen, mirrored in RTL); `none` shows nothing. Do not mix them.

props.name: onDark
props.description: Use `--blue-on-dark` (white on press) on dark surfaces. Defaults to the theme scheme for colour.

props.name: newTabLabel
props.description: Spoken after the label for links that leave the app, e.g. "(opens in a new tab)". Pass it translated.

props.name: textStyle
props.description: Text style, used by `inline` for size and weight inherited from the paragraph.

variants.look: inherits colour; 1px underline grows from the left on hover
Horizon Blue, semibold, 44px hit area; .arrow nudges up-right on hover
header links with the gradient underline (see SiteHeader)

variantNotes: `.cr-link-ink` sets `.lnk` to black at content width on light backgrounds.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: The ↗ rule: put ↗ after the label when the link goes to another page or site. Use ⌄ when it opens something here, and › when it drills into an app screen. Do not mix them.
Links are `--horizon-blue` on light and `--blue-on-dark` on dark. Never pure blue on black.
Keep standalone links at least 44px tall to tap; `.btn-ghost` does this for you.
Inline links stay underlined so they are visible without colour.
External links open in the same tab unless leaving would lose form input.

accessibility: Link text must make sense out of context: "Read the statement of faith", not "here".
Mark the ↗ glyph inside `.arrow` with `aria-hidden="true"`; if the link opens a new tab, add "(opens in a new tab)" as visually hidden text.
Focus uses the shared ring: 2px Horizon Blue outline + `--shadow-focus`.
content: Short and specific: "Our statement of faith ↗", "Browse the directory ↗", "See all", "Get prayer updates ↗".
